# Pixel Coin Clicker

A tiny offline clicker game built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No packages, network requests or external assets.

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. That's it.

## How to play

- Click the big coin (or focus it with Tab and press Enter/Space) to earn 1 point per click.
- Buy an **Auto-clicker** for 10 points. Each Auto-clicker adds 1 point per second.
- The price of the next Auto-clicker doubles after every purchase.
- The buy button is disabled until you can afford the next upgrade.

## Features

- Points, Auto-clicker count and next price displayed live.
- Accessible buttons with visible hover, focus and pressed states.
- Responsive layout that works down to 360px wide.
- Cohesive dark palette with a pixel-style coin drawn in CSS.

## Files

- `index.html` — structure
- `styles.css` — theme and responsive styling
- `game.js` — game state, click handling, auto-clicker tick
